title: integrated-canary-shadow-ab-autorollback-enhancements
author: Jordan Patel
description: Motivation: production rollout workflows need tighter integration between canary weighted traffic, shadow probing, A/B experiments and automated rollback triggers. This PR implements coordinated state transitions across canary/AB/shadow stages, improves metric matching for multi-metric autorollback, and wires end-to-end observability and e2e stability guards. Goals: 1) enable a single 'integrated' rollout object that supports conditional weighted canary, A/B allocation, and optional shadow probing; 2) ensure autorollback triggers evaluate composite metric quorums and respect quarantine stages; 3) surface detailed telemetry for each stage so SREs can diagnose regressions quickly. Changes include runtime routing adjustments, rollout controller state machine updates, metric evaluation improvements, and new e2e tests. Checklist: - [x] controller state machine update and unit tests - [x] routing + prefix KV handling for shadow traffic - [x] composite metric quorum logic for autorollback - [x] stability guard e2e tests (canary + shadow + AB combos) - [x] docs + changelog entry - [x] manual QA on staging (multi-model flow) Related: ENG-2245 (integrated rollout design), ENG-2301 (autorollback composite metrics). This description contains the rationale, high-level design and test plan.

review_comments: Priya Rao: Nice work. Two questions: (1) can you clarify how weight adjustments are atomic across nodes to avoid transient double serving? (2) the composite quorum evaluator needs an opt-out for single-metric rollouts so existing customers don't get unexpected rollbacks.

Jordan Patel (author): For (1) scheduler.go now emits a single 'weight-update' event and the routing layer applies it using a consistent sequence number; added tests in scheduler_test to assert no overlap. For (2) added a 'quorum_mode' field on rollout spec with values ['composite','single'] and preserved default 'single' to maintain backward compatibility.
Ethan Cole: CI initially failed on e2e due to flakiness in the shadow probe timing. Suggest adding a retry/backoff to the probe harness so transient infra jitter doesn't cause false positives.
Jordan Patel: Added a probe retry with exponential backoff and guarded the e2e assertion to allow 3 retries. Reran e2e locally and in CI; stable now.
Samir Patel: Observability change looks good. Please ensure the rollback-reason tag is indexed on the metrics pipeline (Spans + Prometheus labels) — pinged infra to add low-cardinality mapping.
Jordan Patel: Confirmed with infra; mapping queued in ENG-2402. Added a note in rollout docs recommending using the low-cardinality field for dashboards.

merge_outcome: merged via squash (squash and merge) after approvals from Priya and Ethan. Merge commit includes the integrated rollout controller, routing and observer updates. Changelog updated and flagged for release notes.
release_notes: Add integrated rollout object supporting coordinated canary, A/B, and shadow probing with composite-metric autorollback and stability guards. Improves observability for rollback reasons and adds e2e tests. No breaking changes by default; existing rollouts keep single-metric behavior unless 'quorum_mode' is set to composite.
additional_notes: Staged rollout on staging for 48h with synthetic load showed no latency regression. Performance: small 2% p50 increase under 1000rps due to extra tag propagation; follow-up work planned to batch telemetry writes (ENG-2377). Recommend ops enable new telemetry labels in dashboards and add the quarantine-stage alert to SLOs.
